risk_detection: Heuristic candidates plus reviewer findings; absence of flags is not proof of correctness.
selection_explanation: Only explicit unresolved reviewer issues need standard-tier adjudication. Risk flags, corrections, ordinary samples, duplicate-source groups and speaker groups do not trigger standard-tier review. Known standard-tier repair findings are carried to cheap-tier repair without re-reading; exhausted or regressing repairs use the existing targeted standard-tier escalation route.
